data.description: High quality metal, or HQM, is what armor and weapons get built from, used in 93 recipes such as the [Auto Turret](/items/auto-turret), Battering Ram and Chainsaw. Smelt it from [high quality metal ore](/items/high-quality-metal-ore), or buy 50 for around 106 scrap from the [Travelling Vendor](/world/travelling-vendor). 142 items recycle into it: in a Green Recycler, rifle, SMG and semi bodies give 1 with a 50% chance at a second, while pipes, springs, road signs, sheet metal and [tech trash](/items/tech-trash) give 1.
data.name: High Quality Metal
